tagma_revoke_body_named: "{name}" will lose access immediately. The device is disconnected on its next attempt to reach the server, and the tagma disappears from this list.
tagma_revoke_body_unnamed: This tagma will lose access immediately. The device is disconnected on its next attempt to reach the server, and the tagma disappears from this list.
tagma_status_layout_toggle: Toggle status layout (top bar / right sidebar)
tagma_rooms_desc: Rooms this tagma has joined. You can remove it from any of them, even a room you are not a member of.
tagma_rooms_empty: This tagma has not joined any rooms.
tagma_rooms_remove_desc: Remove "{name}" from "{room}"? It will stop receiving messages there.
tagma_rooms_section_empty: No rooms yet -- create one or browse public rooms.
tagma_credential_intro: This tagma authenticates every call with one secret. Its permission list decides what its file-service calls may do.
tagma_credential_effect: A permission change applies to the tagma's next file-service call.
tagma_credential_empty_perms: No permissions. Its file-service calls are authenticated and then refused.
tagma_credential_unreachable_perms: A tagma cannot reach registry routes, so these strings grant nothing. Remove them whenever you like.
tagma_credential_reset_desc: The old secret stops working at once. Write the new one into this tagma's credential file; it takes effect when the tagma next starts.
tagma_credential_new_secret_hint: Write it into this tagma's credential file. It applies the next time the tagma starts.
